metadata.title: Waslix | Know which customers need you
metadata.description: One customer success workspace for health, onboarding, risks, tasks, renewals, and the next action.

hero.description: Waslix gives Customer Success teams one workspace to monitor customer health, manage onboarding, track renewals, coordinate tasks, and act before accounts become at risk.
hero.support: No credit card required · Setup in minutes

fragmented.description: Bring customer records and team activity into one account context. Waslix turns scattered facts into an explainable view of what needs attention.

system.title: Signals. Health. Action.
system.description: Waslix keeps evidence connected from the moment a fact changes to the work your team does next.
system.signalsCopy: Meaningful events enter the customer record with source and context.
system.healthCopy: Four weighted dimensions produce a score without hiding missing or stale evidence.
system.actionCopy: Evidence becomes focused work, not another dashboard to monitor.

health.title: Health scores that explain themselves.
health.description: A score without context is not useful. Waslix shows what is driving each customer's health, where the evidence came from, and how fresh it is.
health.label: Customer health
health.selectFactor: Select a health factor to inspect its evidence

deepDive.title: See the situation, not just the score.
deepDive.description: Move from the portfolio into one customer without losing the evidence, people, work, or renewal context around it.

lifecycle.title: Every stage keeps its context.
lifecycle.description: The account record evolves from first value to renewal. Work, evidence, ownership, and history stay connected.
lifecycle.onboardingCopy: A structured plan with owners, due dates, and delayed milestone detection.
lifecycle.adoptionCopy: Usage and engagement inputs show whether value is becoming repeatable.
lifecycle.healthyCopy: Health drivers and history make the current situation understandable.
lifecycle.expansionCopy: Growth signals stay visible beside the customer relationship.
lifecycle.renewalCopy: Readiness reasons, owner, value, and stage make the date actionable.

collaboration.title: Customer success is a team sport.
collaboration.description: CSMs, managers, account executives, and support work from the same account history without turning the customer record into a chat room.

renewals.title: Never get surprised by a renewal.
renewals.description: See upcoming value, readiness, health, owner, and the evidence behind each renewal before the date becomes urgent.

intelligence.title: Waslix watches the portfolio with you.
intelligence.description: Deterministic signals surface the accounts that changed, explain why, and connect the evidence to a useful next action.
intelligence.highRiskBody: Health fell 14 points. Three stakeholders are inactive. Renewal is in 45 days.
intelligence.expansionBody: Usage increased and the active team grew from 22 to 38 users.
intelligence.reengageBody: The executive sponsor has no meaningful activity for 28 days.

demo.title: Watch evidence change the account.
demo.description: Toggle realistic health inputs. Waslix recalculates the score and keeps the reasons visible.
demo.label: Interactive health simulation
demo.suggestionAttention: Review the account with its owner

integrations.title: Connect the signals that matter.
integrations.description: Waslix currently supports native workspace records and CSV customer import. Direct external connections are planned and are not presented as live.

final.title: Run Customer Success from one place.
final.description: Build your workspace, invite your team, and start managing customer health, onboarding, renewals, and growth with Waslix.
